content: Obesity is a known risk factor for developing several cancers, including breast, colon, and gynecologic carcinomas. <sup>1, 2</sup> Recent research has clarified that obesity not only correlates with carcinogenesis but also influences the prognosis for many cancer patients. For example, obesity has been associated with a poor prognosis in patients with breast<sup>3, 4</sup> and colon<sup>5, 6</sup> cancers. However, some studies have reported a favorable prognosis in obese patients diagnosed with gastric<sup>7</sup> or renal<sup>8</sup> cancers.
